script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Woodpool Leather ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Aapka account 2087 din purana hai, lekin pichle poore 30 din mein ek bhi active day nahi tha aur zero enquiries aayi hain — yeh dekh ke mujhe seedha aapse baat karni thi.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kya platform pe koi specific problem aa rahi hai jaise catalog visibility, product listing, ya phir aapko lag raha hai ki leather segment mein buyers hi nahi hain is waqt? Aapka experience kya raha hai recently?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important data point share karta hoon — aapka CQS score 85 hai, jo actually kaafi strong hai, matlab aapki catalog quality theek hai. Problem lead supply side pe hai: is demand tier mein market mein 0.0 BLs per paid seller hain, trend flat hai — toh yeh sirf aapki problem nahi, pura segment Red tier mein hai. Lekin iska matlab yeh bhi hai ki jo seller ab active rahega, woh thin competition mein sab leads capture karega.
script_parts.action: Abhi call pe hi aapka catalog kholta hoon — ek kaam karte hain: aapke top 2-3 products ke titles aur keywords check karte hain aur agar koi quick fix hai toh turant update karte hain, taaki jab bhi koi buyer search kare toh aap visible rahein.
script_parts.close: Bhai, main aapse koi bada commitment nahi maang raha — bas yeh ek cheez: agle 7 din mein ek baar platform login karein aur jo updates humne abhi discuss kiye, woh apply karein. Kya yeh ho sakta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Woodpool Leather ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. Your account is 2087 days old, but in the last 30 days there have been zero active days and zero enquiries — that's what prompted me to reach out directly today.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — is there a specific issue you've been facing on the platform, like catalog visibility, product listings, or do you feel that buyer demand in the leather segment has simply dried up? What has your recent experience been like?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's an important data point — your CQS score is 85, which is actually quite strong, meaning your catalog quality is solid. The issue is on the lead supply side: in your demand tier, the market has 0.0 BLs per paid seller with a flat trend — so this isn't just your problem, the entire segment is in the Red tier. But this also means that whichever seller stays active now will capture all available leads in a low-competition environment.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll review the titles and keywords on your top 2-3 products together, and if there are any quick fixes, we'll update them immediately so you're visible whenever a buyer searches.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not asking for a big commitment from you — just one thing: log in to the platform once in the next 7 days and apply the updates we just discussed. Can we agree on that?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
